name: Vista
fix_description: In flashLoan, returned tokens are burned directly at the end without checking if they include staked tokens. This bypasses the stake constraint that should prevent selling staked tokens. Attacker flash-loans tokens, buys cheap from stake contract, sells at higher price elsewhere, returns flash loan (tokens get burned bypassing lock). Fix: check stake status before burning returned tokens, or add flash-loan guard on the stake contract.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a multi-step, protocol-specific attack: take a flash loan, swap assets, stake into a presale to obtain VISTA, abuse VISTA's flashLoan/free-balance accounting, then sell and repay. While the PoC is short, understanding why the token burn/freeze check omission is exploitable requires reading custom token/presale/sale logic rather than spotting a generic single-call bug.
